editorial:
Imagine you and your best friends decide to pull a prank by hiding in a giant movie theater after the lights go out. That is exactly what happens to Niccolò and his group of friends. Niccolò is just trying to get his life back together after a mental breakdown, and he loves scary movies. He and his friends, including Viola, Ambra, and a few others, head to a massive multiplex that everyone says is cursed. The vibe starts off as a fun night out, but it quickly turns into a nightmare when they realize they are not alone in the dark. The creepy security guard adds a layer of tension that makes you feel like someone is always watching from the shadows.

You will notice that the movie relies heavily on suspense and the scary layout of the theater. The acting is decent for this kind of flick, and the twists keep you guessing until the end. While some parts feel a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you love movies where a group of teens makes bad decisions, you will enjoy this one.
endingExplained: The group discovers that the cinema is actually a trap for a series of kills. The twist reveals that the security guard is not just mean, but a murderer who uses the theater to hunt people. After a lot of running and screaming, most of the friends are killed off in brutal ways. Niccolò has to fight for his life in a final struggle, showing that the urban legends about the place were actually true all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slashers and urban legends.
